verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork's documented scheduled tasks let users delegate work that runs automatically on a recurring basis or on demand, delivering reports, briefings and summaries on the user's schedule. Cowork is also positioned as letting you describe an outcome, step away, and return to finished work, which is autonomous execution in the background. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably unattended, and documentation of event-based triggers or of whether tasks run when the desktop app is closed.
